intended_object: The inclusion map that sends an element of the Wasserstein component {μ ∈ P(X) : W_p(μ₀, μ) < ∞} to its underlying probability measure in P(X). Inferred from the docstring, the `@[coe]` attribute and the module documentation.
explanation: `WassersteinComponent p μ₀` is a type synonym for the subtype of `ProbabilityMeasure X` cut out by `wassersteinEDist p μ₀ μ ≠ ∞`. `toProbabilityMeasure` is `μ.1`, the subtype projection. That is exactly the inclusion of the component into the space of probability measures, and the library proves right after the definition that it is injective. The library keeps the subtype body hidden behind a type synonym, so it needs a named projection; this is that projection, a thin wrapper around `Subtype.val`. It is stated in the same generality as the type it comes from (any measurable, pseudo-extended-metric space `X`, any exponent `p`), so it is not too narrow, and there is no discrepancy with the intended map.
